steps: Via MCP conkay_solver_list (or the registry): orc.intent-parse is listed with regime/units/tolerance/screening declared.

Open a design whose node carries props["orc.intent"] = {text: "design a footbridge over the creek, 12 m span, 3 m wide"} — envelope orc.intent-parse@<node> is PASS, outputs.domain == "truss", inputs.text echoes the request verbatim, and every outputs.quantities[].raw appears literally in the text.
Re-open with proposed: [{name: "load", value: 900, unit: "N"}] added — the proposal is in rejectedProposals with a literal-re-find reason, and no admitted quantity carries 900.
Re-open with text "an electric kettle holding 1.7 L, 2200 W" — envelope is WARN with outputs.domain null and missing ["domain"], quantities traced (1.7 L, 2200 W).
title: orc.intent-parse: a footbridge brief parses to a truss brief with every number traced; an invented proposed number is rejected by literal re-find
